_comment: Canonical demo verification records. `verifyBase` is the PRODUCTION target baked into the published samples; `testVerifyBase` is the TEST target used only by the owner's physical-scan QA artifacts under docs/qa-artifacts (never published). The QR encodes the Verification ID alone — no token is involved in either build, so no secret value exists in this repository, in a build environment, or in any generated file. The Verification IDs below are public demonstration records and appear only inside QR module geometry, never as visible page text.
